summary: Off Apple platforms, Synchronization is the Swift toolchain's own module (Isomer builds with Swift 6.3.2), the same open-source code as Apple's. What differs is what is newer in Apple's SDK than the toolchain, or what the platform cannot have (WebAssembly without threads has no blocking wait).

groups.title: Newer than the Swift 6.3.2 toolchain, or not on WebAssembly
groups.intent: arrives when Isomer moves to the next Swift release
groups.why: Apple's SDK carries a newer Synchronization than Swift 6.3.2's; the wasm SDK's leaves out what single-threaded WebAssembly cannot do.
